title: Stonecut Wood
description: A datapack that enables the use of the stone cutter on Wooden logs.
body:
# Stonecut Wood by LexianDEV

# What's it do?
This datapack allows you to use the stonecutter on wooden logs, which could be good for challenges and general ease of use, it gives more functionality to the stonecutter as well.
